desc:
🧸 Welcome to Squishy Blind Box!

How to Play:
🔍 Scan the box piles to find hidden crates!
💪 Pull them out and carry them to the bench!
✂️ Cut the box and reveal the squishy inside!
✨ Hunt rare finds, plus Silver, Gold and Rainbow ones!
🧸 Squish your collection. Every one has its own sound!
🏪 Stock your own store and earn Cash from Shoppers!
⬆️ Buy stronger Gloves, better Scanners and sharper Cutters!
🏭 Unlock New Worlds with Higher Luck!

🎧 Scanner beeps, tape cuts and soft squishes. Pure ASMR!

👍 Like the game and join the group for a FREE gift!
🔔 Follow for updates and free codes!

📱 Play on PC, Mobile, Tablet and Console!

Grab your scanner. Your first crate is waiting!
